_meta.priceMethod: Kayak.com (US site, USD) hotel page, 'last 12 months' figures. OTA low = cheapest-month average nightly price; OTA high = most-expensive-month average; blended ADR = average of the two. Kayak averages are search prices, may include taxes/fees, and are not achieved ADR.
_meta.rule: Rooms and street address require 2 independent sources. Postal code is kept only when no fetched source conflicts.
